EmailTemplate.subject: ITA - FAQ 2023 Requests
EmailTemplate.textOnly:
Hello {!Contact.FirstName}
Thank you for contacting Insperity Time & Attendance Support. Some accrual plans are configured to forecast accruals, meaning they will show all scheduled accruals for the year in advance, while others are configured to simply populate the employees’ accrual transactions as they go. Since your system is currently not programmed to forecast accruals, 2023 accruals will not populate for employees until the ‘current pay period’ in your Time & Attendance system reflects 2023 dates. At that time, employees will be able to request time off in 2023 as expected.
If you have additional questions or concerns or would like to update your configuration to allow forecasting, please let us know and we will be happy to help.
Thank you,
